chunks: Ḥumayd ibn Ziyād, from al-Ḥasan ibn Muḥammad ibn Samāʿah, from Jaʿfar ibn Samāʿah, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Ismāʿīl ibn al-Faḍl, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about false accusation against the People of the Covenant and the People of the Book: is the Muslim given the prescribed hadd punishment for falsely accusing them? He said: “No, but he is given taʿzīr.”

key_terms.يُعَزَّرُ: he is subjected to discretionary punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on falsely accusing Ahl al-Dhimmah and Ahl al-Kitab in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on false accusation against Ahl al-Dhimmah and Ahl al-Kitab. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that the prescribed hadd punishment is not applied in such a case, but discretionary chastisement is imposed instead.
